Delete this comment before you open the pull request.

The title and the description become the commit on develop, so write them
as a commit message. CONTRIBUTING.md has the details and an example.

Title: type(scope): what changes. Imperative, lowercase, no final period,
65 characters at most.

Description: plain text, no Markdown headings. Say what is wrong or missing
today, then what this change does and why. Add what it costs or breaks, if
anything. End with "Fixes #123" or "Refs #123" when there is an issue.

Notes meant only for the review, such as the commands you ran or where to
start reading, belong in a first comment, not here.
